decided: Only when the user signs off on each change does orbit stop with an error naming a folder of decision records, or the folder holding the change account, that exists but cannot be opened, wherever it works out which records still need a reader. With any other sign-off value it treats such a folder as empty, exactly as before. This narrows the rule recorded earlier the same night, which applied under every setting.
alternatives: Stop on such a folder under every sign-off setting, which changes what a default install does on that error and would need G0 to name a new exception.
Keep reading an unopenable folder as empty under every setting, leaving the records unread without saying so even when the user signs off on what was read.
why: When the user signs off on each change, a folder read as empty would let the user sign believing nothing is unread, so it must fail loudly; with sign-off off nothing is signed, and G0 keeps a default install exactly as today. The user chose this narrower rule at the review walk.
detail: selectUnreadRecords runs assertListable on decisions/ and account/ only when resolveSignoffSetting is change (src/core/decision-records.ts); orbit-emit-composition and orbit-decision-records deltas and docs/cli.md state the refusal for that value.
